BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-13 commit 5302f71. 27 content files + 8 ADRs. Methodology v1.5. STAGES DONE THROUGH 18.7. Spine: 22 stages (18 + inserted 16.5, 18.5, 18.6, 18.7).

READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST.

STAGE 18.7 = 00t-acts-15-and-the-four-requirements.md (OWN FILE — Acts 15 is where BOTH investigations converged independently: circumcision arrived here in Stage 17, food arrived straight back in 18.6; and it produces two new instruments).

PROBLEM RECONSTRUCTED FIRST: Acts 15:5's proposition has TWO elements — circumcise them AND command them to keep the Torah of Moses — proposed by people LUKE CALLS BELIEVERS. THE DISPUTE IS INSIDE THE BELIEVING COMMUNITY, not Christianity vs Judaism. The council decides against THAT proposition, which is NARROWER than 'against Torah'.

Acts 15:9 'cleansed their HEARTS by faith' joins converging threads: heart-circumcision (Deut 10:16, 30:6; Jer 4:4) / heart-cleansing / Ruach / faith. Recorded as CONVERGENCE not citation.

'THE YOKE' (15:10) HELD OPEN. Commonly read as 'Torah itself was an unbearable burden' — BUT Deut 30:11 ('not too hard for you'; CJB 'not beyond your reach'), Psalm 19:7 ('the law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul'; CJB 19:8 'the Torah of Adonai is perfect, restoring the inner person'), 1 John 5:3 ('his commandments are not burdensome') describe it very differently. FOUR CANDIDATES: Torah as given / entire covenantal administration / THE DEMAND THAT GENTILES BECOME CIRCUMCISED PROSELYTES AND ASSUME FULL MOSAIC LEGAL IDENTITY / the accumulated manner of administration. Context strongly ties it to the proposition actually on the table at 15:5. NARROWEST SUPPORTED READING TAKEN per standing practice. Open q 38.

*** THIRD CONFIRMED VERSIFICATION OFFSET: CJB numbers PSALM 19:7 as 19:8 *** (superscription counted as verse 1). Surfaced the same way as Jeremiah 31 — a direct fetch returned the wrong verse (the sun's circuit). Prior offsets: Jeremiah 31 (one verse), Zechariah 2:6.

James appeals to AMOS 9:11-12 — Gentile inclusion interpreted THROUGH the prophetic story, not as Israel's story abandoned. Acts 15:14 'taking from among the Goyim a people to bear his name'.

THE GAR MATTERS: Acts 15:21's 'FOR' (Greek gar) normally introduces a reason/explanation. James is NOT randomly changing subject; there IS a logical relation between v.20 and v.21. READING A: the four are what makes JEWISH/GENTILE TABLE FELLOWSHIP possible, since Moses is read everywhere and these sensitivities are universally known — v.21 explains why THESE issues were urgent. READING B: the four are INITIAL requirements, not the whole curriculum — converts will keep hearing Moses and learning. *** BRAKE: v.21 does NOT say 'Gentiles will attend synagogue every Sabbath and gradually learn the rest of Torah'. READING B IS AN INFERENCE — possibly strong, worth investigating, BUT CANNOT BE UPGRADED TO TEXTUAL STATEMENT BECAUSE IT FITS A HYPOTHESIS. *** THIRD POSSIBILITY: A and B not mutually exclusive. FOURTH: James may not be constructing our later theological categories at all — 'entry requirement or permanent list?' may be a question the text never answered. Open q 39 (supersedes/expands q26).

*** THE REDUCTIO — needs no lexical or historical work, just reading the list and asking what it omits *** If Acts 15 gave Gentiles only four rules, were they permitted to MURDER, STEAL, BEAR FALSE WITNESS, DISHONOR PARENTS? None is among the four. THEREFORE THE FOUR REQUIREMENTS CANNOT CONSTITUTE AN EXHAUSTIVE LIST OF MORAL OBLIGATION FOR GENTILE BELIEVERS. Whatever Acts 15 is doing, it is NOT the entire ethical content of discipleship in four bullet points.

WHY THESE FOUR — LEVITICUS 17-18, and the overlap is with PRECISELY THE LAWS TORAH APPLIED TO BOTH ISRAELITES AND RESIDENT FOREIGNERS: Lev 17:10 blood ('or of the strangers who sojourn among them'), 17:12 (restated), 18:26 sexual prohibitions ('either the native or the stranger who sojourns among you'), plus Lev 17's improper-slaughter/sacrifice. Maps onto Acts 15's idol pollution / sexual immorality / strangled / blood. SERIOUS INTERTEXTUAL HYPOTHESIS, NOT ANNOUNCED AS ESTABLISHED. Open q 40.

NEW GLOSSARY: GER (Hebrew ger) = sojourner / resident alien / foreigner living among Israel. NOT a native-born Israelite; NOT simply an unrelated distant foreigner. Non-native dwelling AMONG Israel, participating to some degree in communal life; Torah gives him BOTH protections AND obligations. NUMBERS 15:15-16: 'one statute for you and for the stranger who sojourns with you... ONE LAW AND ONE RULE'; CJB 'the same Torah and standard of judgment'. THE TANAKH ALREADY CONTAINS CATEGORIES FOR FOREIGNERS ATTACHING TO YAHWEH'S PEOPLE — Gentile inclusion doesn't appear from nowhere in Acts (converges with Ex 12:48, Ezek 47:22-23, Ruth). BRAKE: DO NOT FLATTEN GER INTO 'GENTILE CHRISTIAN' — ancient Israel under Sinai and a first-century Gentile follower of Yeshua are historically and covenantally different situations. Legitimate question is whether James DREW UPON those requirements, not whether the categories are identical.

*** THE TEXTUAL ASYMMETRY, LET TO STAND *** EXPLICITLY COMMANDED for Gentiles: blood / strangled meat / idol pollution / sexual immorality. EXPLICITLY ABSENT: UNCLEAN ANIMAL SPECIES. If James drew from Lev 17-18, LEVITICUS 11'S CLASSIFICATION IS CONSPICUOUSLY NOT REPRODUCED. THIS IS REAL EVIDENCE AGAINST ASSUMING THE COUNCIL IMPOSED THE ENTIRE LEVITICAL DIETARY CODE ON GENTILES, AND IT IS NOT EXPLAINED AWAY. BUT Acts 15:21 BLOCKS the opposite conclusion ('therefore Moses no longer matters') since James invokes Moses being read every Sabbath in the very next sentence. BOTH SIMPLISTIC ANSWERS HIT A WALL — THAT IS THE FINDING. Open q 41.

PETER'S SILENCE AT THE COUNCIL: in the ONE setting where a dietary argument would have been maximally useful — in front of the people who most needed convincing — he says Yahweh cleansed their HEARTS. He never says 'remember my vision? Yahweh abolished the food laws.' THIRD INDEPENDENT LINE pointing the same way (10:28 his own interpretation; 11:18 Luke's conclusion; the USE of the episode here). A man defending a position tends to use his strongest available argument; Peter didn't use that one.

*** NEW FORMAL RULE — COVENANTAL TRANSMISSION (00b + methodology v1.5) *** When people from outside Israel are incorporated into Messiah's people, ask of EACH prior covenantal command: is it explicitly REAFFIRMED / TRANSFORMED / UNIVERSALIZED / SPIRITUALLY DEEPENED / LEFT UNSTATED / or ATTACHED TO A PRIOR ADMINISTRATION? REPLACES the malformed 'is Torah abolished — yes or no?'. BLOCKS BOTH ERRORS: 'one Mosaic command changed administratively -> all must change identically' (refuted by circumcision AND Acts 15's explicit retentions) and 'one Torah command continues -> all continue identically' (refuted by Messiah's priesthood). THE UNIT OF ANALYSIS MUST BE GRANULAR: what does Scripture do with THIS particular command across the covenant story? PAIRS WITH JURISDICTION — Jurisdiction looks BACKWARD to a command's origin; Transmission looks FORWARD through the covenant story. CURRENT TABLE: circumcision = transformed around heart/Ruach, not imposed physically as salvation requirement. blood/sexual holiness/idolatry/strangled = EXPLICITLY RETAINED for Gentiles. sacrificial system = fulfilled/reconfigured. clean animal species = STILL UNDER INVESTIGATION, conspicuously absent from the decree. Sabbath = SEPARATE INVESTIGATION REQUIRED.

*** NEXT STAGE: ACTS 21:17-26 — THE CONTROL CASE THAT CANNOT BE SKIPPED *** Years after the council Paul returns to Jerusalem. THREE THINGS IN PLAY, NONE RESOLVED: (1) Acts 21:20 'MANY THOUSANDS' of Jewish believers 'ALL ZEALOUS FOR THE LAW' (CJB 'tens of thousands... zealots for the Torah') — as a NORMAL STATE OF AFFAIRS DECADES IN. (2) Acts 21:21 the charge that Paul taught JEWS to FORSAKE MOSES (not circumcising their children, not walking according to the customs) treated as a FALSE RUMOR REQUIRING PUBLIC REFUTATION. (3) Acts 21:26 PAUL ENTERING THE TEMPLE, PURIFYING HIMSELF, WITH AN OFFERING PRESENTED — AFTER Hebrews' 'once for all'. AND: ACTS 21:25 may be the single most clarifying sentence available for what Acts 15 did and did not mean, because years later JAMES EXPLICITLY DISTINGUISHES what was decided about GENTILE believers from what is expected of JEWISH believers, IN THE SAME BREATH.

Vault standard is Yeshua HaMashiach (not YahuShua) — user is aware of/has used the YahuShua transliteration but explicitly decided 2026-08-08 to keep Yeshua as the vault's standing term. Do not silently switch if it comes up again — this was a deliberate choice, not an oversight.

COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.
